questionEn: Which formulation more accurately distinguishes "relative atomic mass of an element" from similar ideas?
questionUz: Qaysi formulada "elementning nisbiy atom massasi" shunga o'xshash g'oyalardan aniqroq farqlanadi?
choicesEn: this is a physical quantity that shows how many times the mass of an atom of a chemical element is greater than 1/12.
this is a physical quantity that shows how many times the mass of an atom of a chemical element is greater.

explanationEn: The relative atomic mass of an element is a physical quantity that shows how many times the mass of an atom of a chemical element is greater than 1/12 the mass of a carbon atom.
explanationUz: Elementning nisbiy atom massasi - bu kimyoviy element atomining massasi uglerod atomi massasining 1/12 qismidan necha marta katta ekanligini ko'rsatadigan fizik miqdor.
